name: APT29 Collection 1 - Documents Located and Copied to a Collection Folder (T1005 / T1083)
blast_radius: Creates a synthetic user profile of eight files in a run-tagged temp directory, finds documents by extension and copies six into a collection folder. The real profile is never searched.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: file creation in the collection folder
detection: EDR: bulk copy of documents into one directory by a script host

name: APT29 Collection 2 - Remote Data Staging on the Loopback Administrative Share (T1074.002)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT29_REMOTE_STAGING=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates a run-tagged folder under C:/Users/Public through the loopback C$ share, copies four synthetic files into it, verifies them and removes the folder.
telemetry: Security EID 5140 and 5145: administrative share access with the run-tagged path
detection: SIEM: file writes over C$ from a non-administration host or process
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:PUBLIC '.') -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT29 Collection 3 - Collected Files Archived with a Utility and Verified (T1560.001)
blast_radius: Archives five synthetic files with tar.exe into a run-tagged zip, lists it and extracts it to confirm every hash matches. Not encrypted. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: tar.exe with a run-tagged archive path
detection: EDR: archive utility run on a collection folder by a script host
